message:
Running command: # Check what headers are available for libunistring
find /usr/include -name "unitypes.h" -o -name "unistr.h" -o -name "uniconv.h" -o -name "uninorm.h" -o -name "unictype.h" 2>/dev/null
# Also check if there's a pkg-config for it
pkg-config --cflags --libs libunistring 2>/dev/null || echo "no pkg-config for libunistring"
